evidence.description: US DOJ False Claims Act settlement (2018): Benevis and 130+ affiliated Kool Smiles clinics paid $23.9M to resolve allegations they billed Medicaid for medically unnecessary pediatric procedures — baby root canals, extractions and stainless-steel crowns on children (2009–2011) — with dentists pressured by production-quota bonuses. Settled without admission of wrongdoing. Conduct and settlement PREDATE New Mountain Capital's 2020 bankruptcy acquisition (then-owners FFL Partners, later Tailwind/Littlejohn).

Arizona AG consent judgment (April 2012, ~$395,000): resolved a 2011 lawsuit alleging ARS used false, misleading and deceptive sales tactics against (often older) consumers — including fake 'safety notices' to frighten buyers into unnecessary systems and official-looking solicitations — and undermined buyers' 3-day cancellation rights. ARS agreed to substantial changes in its sales practices. Predates GI Partners' 2020 ownership.

Massachusetts AG settlement announced Jan 5, 2023 ($3.5M): resolved a 2021 lawsuit alleging Aspen used bait-and-switch advertising — charging patients for exams/x-rays/screenings it advertised as free and claiming to accept all insurance when it did not accept MassHealth Medicaid. Aspen agreed to return up to $750K to affected patients.

California AG settlement (May 2026): Aspen agreed to $2M in penalties plus $300K restitution over alleged illegal corporate practice of dentistry and false/misleading advertising, with injunctive terms barring it from directing clinical practice or replacing practice-owner dentists of its choosing.
